name: fig_cryostat_schematic
title: Dilution-refrigerator stack and where the heat budget applies
question: Where in the refrigerator does the Demo B heat-budget constraint act, and which documented numbers enter it?
model: Schematic only (no physics computed); the boxed total and verdict are the Lean output for Demo B.
data: Numbers from data/cryostats/bluefors_ld.json (bluefors_ld400_hdw: temperature.base ev_bf_0003, cooling_power.at_20mK ev_bf_0006, cooling_power.at_100mK ev_bf_0007, electrical.coax_lines) and data/experiments/quantum_mxc_wiring_heat_budget.json (line counts hl_033, per-line loads hl_011, hl_017, hl_019, hl_029); total and verdict from paper/data/fig_heat_budget.json (Lean).
caption: Illustrative stack of a cryogen-free dilution refrigerator (plates drawn as discs, wiring as vertical lines; geometry, plate spacing and line positions are not to scale). Annotated numbers are the sourced LD400 specifications in CryoLean's catalog and the per-line loads of the Demo B heat-budget profile; the heat-budget constraint is evaluated at the mixing-chamber plate, where the Lean checker compares the margin-weighted wiring load (14.592 µW) with the documented cooling power at 20 mK (12 µW).
